settings-ownedusageskeletonmigration--da.expression: () => { const host=document.querySelector('[data-usage-skeleton-ready="true"]'); const card=host?.querySelector('[role=status][aria-busy=true]'); if (!card) return false; const scope=host.dataset.usageSkeletonScope; if (scope!=='default' && getComputedStyle(card).getPropertyValue('--spacing').trim()!=='7px') return false; const maximum=Number(host.dataset.usageSkeletonMaxWidth); if (maximum) { const container=[...card.querySelectorAll('*')].find(el=>getComputedStyle(el).containerType==='inline-size'); if (!container || Math.abs(container.getBoundingClientRect().width-(Math.min(innerWidth,maximum)-34))>0.01) return false; } return true; }
